story.title: Keller ISD eyes May bond election after voters reject $828M proposal
story.summary: A newly elected trustee and bond committee member want a smaller proposal, clearer project details and more community input before another vote. Keller ISD could ask voters to consider a smaller bond in May. During a Nov. 16 board meeting, Superintendent Cory Wilson told trustees that district leaders will consult community committees and the newly seated school board about another election after voters rejected an $828 million bond Nov. 3. “There’s a lot of work that needs to take place within the school district, and a bond is critical to that work,” Wilson said. Keller ISD should return to voters in May 2027, newly elected trustee Barbara Brewer told the Fort Worth Report.
